title: Podman build error using --build-context to override build-arg FROM source as a variable
body:
### Issue Description In my main project, I've been attempting to optimize my container builds using shared base images and the `additional_contexts` property in my compose.yaml. I've debugged this with both podman and docker and narrowed it down to provide a specific small use case to demonstrate the build error happening in podman on windows with podman compose verbose output giving me the same command being run in both cases and a small change in the containerfile causing the error which doesn't happen in docker. To demonstrate I have 3 files: **compose.yaml** ``` services: my-nginx-web: container_name: my-nginx-web build: context: . dockerfile: nginx.web.containerfile additional_contexts: my-nginx-base: service:my-nginx-base ports: - "8080:80" my-nginx-base: container_name: my-nginx-base build: context: . dockerfile: nginx.base.containerfile ``` **nginx.base.containerfile** ``` FROM nginx:alpine RUN echo "This is the base image for nginx" > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html CMD ["echo", ""] ``` **nginx.web.containerfile - Working** ``` ARG BASE_IMAGE=my-nginx-base # FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} # **Main issue seems to be here** FROM my-nginx-base RUN echo "

This is the web image for nginx added at layer 2" >> /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"] ``` **nginx.web.containerfile - Broken** ``` ARG BASE_IMAGE=my-nginx-base FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} # FROM my-nginx-base RUN echo "

This is the web image for nginx added at layer 2" >> /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"] ``` This sample is outside my more complex project but demonstrates the issue I'm running into. My intention is to use the `additional_contexts` `service:...` property to tell podman compose the dependency order to build my container images in. This works when using the hard coded `FROM my-nginx-base` value in the `nginx.web.containerfile` file. The resulting build commands from `podman-compose` debugging are: ``` podman build -f .\nginx.base.containerfile -t podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-base . podman build -f .\nginx.web.containerfile -t podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-web --build-context=my-nginx-base=docker://localhost/podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-base . ``` When using the hardcoded `FROM` value podman resolves `my-nginx-base` image correctly and the build succeeds. ``` PS C:\Projects\podman_base_image_arg_bug> podman build -f .\nginx.web.containerfile -t podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-web --build-context=my-nginx-base=docker://localhost/podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-base . STEP 1/3: FROM localhost/podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-base STEP 2/3: RUN echo "

This is the web image for nginx added at layer 2" >> /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html --> Using cache 865b94ebc05630465e9db63583ad75b5ad54721aaf1bffe71e18bd6d31bed072 --> 865b94ebc056 STEP 3/3: CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"] --> Using cache 2c2c17d9a6432dc761659be0d95947cfb26c61ce8d697c766df588d55addcf1f COMMIT podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-web --> 2c2c17d9a643 Successfully tagged localhost/podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-web:latest Successfully tagged localhost/test_podman_compose_build_my-nginx-web:latest 2c2c17d9a6432dc761659be0d95947cfb26c61ce8d697c766df588d55addcf1f ``` However, when changing to use the `FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}` ARG value this causes podman to get confused trying to resolve the FROM image name and it tries looking it up on docker.io and fails: ``` PS C:\Projects\podman_base_image_arg_bug> podman build -f .\nginx.web.containerfile -t podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-web --build-context=my-nginx-base=docker://localhost/podman_base_image_arg_bug_my-nginx-base . STEP 1/3: FROM my-nginx-base Resolving "my-nginx-base" using unqualified-search registries (/etc/containers/registries.conf.d/999-podman-machine.conf) Trying to pull docker.io/library/my-nginx-base:latest... Error: creating build container: unable to copy from source docker://my-nginx-base:latest: initializing source docker://my-nginx-base:latest: reading manifest latest in docker.io/library/my-nginx-base: requested access to the resource is denied ``` Performing the same operation in docker builds successfully using the ARG FROM variable. ### Steps to reproduce the issue Steps to reproduce the issue 1. Copy the three files above into a directory together - compose.yaml - nginx.base.containerfile - nginx.web.containerfile (Broken) 2. Build my-nginx-base container using the directory name in the tag (how podman compose handles prefixing as the project name) - `podman build -f .\nginx.base.containerfile -t [dirname]_my-nginx-base . 3. Try and build my-nginx-web container using the base image as a variable name - `podman build -f .\nginx.web.containerfile -t [dirname]_my-nginx-web --build-context=my-nginx-base=docker://localhost/[dirname]_my-nginx-base .` 4. Receive build error ### Describe the results you received When trying to use the base image name as a build-arg variable, Podman seems to get confused and tries to look up the base image container name from docker.io instead of locally like it does with the hard coded value. ### Describe the results you expected I expected Podman to resolve the local base container image like it does with the hard coded `FROM my-nginx-base` value when building using a build-arg as the `FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}` variable name. ### podman info output ```yaml Client: APIVersion: 6.1.4 Built: 1791838521 BuiltTime: Mon Oct 12 17:55:21 2026 GitCommit: 464c15fec06f0074c916f9eff87c4806869c2833 GoVersion: go1.26.8 Os: windows OsArch: windows/amd64 Version: 6.1.4 host: arch: amd64 buildahVersion: 1.42.2 cdiSpecDirs: null cgroupControllers: - I was unclear if this might be an issue with one or the other but they appear to behave the same way with the same result.
